title: CrypticBio: A Large Multimodal Dataset for Visually Confusing Biodiversity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing zero-shot image classification performance using different text modalities (scientific terminology, English-only vernacular names, and mixed multicultural/multilingual common names) to assess the impact of inclusive species terminology.

Measuring the impact of incorporating geographic location embeddings into zero-shot classification models to observe if predictions anchor to latent spatial sampling biases and regional observation frequencies present in the training distribution.
